result.summary:
Implemented SAC-246 and completed all 32 OpenSpec tasks. The Worker API uses D1 for indexed lifecycle state, R2 for exact text bodies, and the static asset binding for the one-screen UI.

Addressed Claude’s proof findings with a new remote collection: an empty shelf, two-snippet save/read/delete flow, visibly distinct fresh-browser first paint and selection, both blank-field errors, literal markup, and a real remote capacity rejection. Added `scripts/verify-remote-storage.mjs` to preserve raw API, D1, and R2 output in one Showboat record. The labeled synthetic capacity reservations were verified, proved that Overflow created no row, and then removed.

Current checks passed: formatting, TypeScript, production build, and all 16 tests. Expected stderr came only from deliberate failure injection in lifecycle tests. Nine inspected screenshots and one raw storage Showboat record are selected for review.

Remote proof ran at https://deos-tmp-873042d0a43055bc7dd07526.skundu.workers.dev with one D1 and one R2 binding. Live release has not begun. The temporary environment will be retired by the DEOS publication lifecycle after durable PR proof is saved.

Implementation remains aligned with Cloudflare’s [D1 prepared statements](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/worker-api/prepared-statements/), [R2 Workers API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/workers/workers-api-reference/), and [static asset binding](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/static-assets/binding/) documentation.
assumptions: The accepted human clarification supersedes the earlier Cloudflare 1042 blocker and authorizes the repaired temporary environment.
The local preview relay failure is not a prerequisite; final behavior and storage proof used the supported remote temporary Worker.
DEOS will retire the run-owned Worker, D1 database, and R2 bucket after publishing durable PR proof because no direct author cleanup capability is exposed.
